screenshots.observations: The physical-checksum mission is selected and awaiting dispatch. The single delivery task is ready and unassigned, task progress is 0/1, and Start mission is available. The page shows the demo operator and one online runner.

The same physical-checksum mission is Failed, its task reports verification failed, and progress remains 0/1 with 1/2 selected run checks passed. The result directs the operator to inspect the saved work. Provider evidence remains downloadable and the failed run's worktree is visibly preserved; there is no accepted source-deliverable action.

The canonical-checksum mission is selected and awaiting dispatch, with one ready unassigned task, 0/1 progress and Start mission available. The previous physical-checksum mission remains visibly Failed in the queue.

The canonical-checksum mission and its task are Completed. The result shows 1/1 task complete, 2/2 run checks passed, and Download source bundle. Separate provider-evidence and Commit Branch source-deliverable downloads are visible; automated verification reports all checks passed. The worktree is preserved and integration is Ready for Review. The page explicitly distinguishes completion from deployment, and outcome review remains unavailable.
